mapper.select: /* AppMySafetyHistoryMapper.selectMyInspectionHistory */ SELECT D.CHKPT_CD AS chkptCd , T.CHKPT_NM AS chkptNm , D.INSPECT_ITEM_CD AS inspectItemCd , I.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ AS inspectItemSubj , D.WORK_DATE AS workDate , DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(D.WORK_DATE, '%Y%m%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS occurredDate , CASE WHEN D.INSPECT_ANSWER_TYPE = 'Y' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS inspectAnswerType , D.ANSWER_DESC AS answerDesc , D.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(D.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', D.FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS filePath FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ANSWER D INNER JOIN TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT T ON ( T.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND T.SITE_CD = D.SITE_CD AND T.CHKPT_CD = D.CHKPT_CD ) INNER JOIN TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM I ON ( I.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND I.CHKLST_TYPE = T.CHKLST_TYPE AND I.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = D.INSPECT_ITEM_CD ) WHERE D.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND D.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND D.INSERT_NO = #{userCd} ORDER BY D.WORK_DATE DESC, D.CHKPT_CD, I.SORT_IDX, D.INSPECT_ITEM_CD

/* AppMySafetyHistoryMapper.selectMyRiskHistory */ SELECT A.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , A.RISK_TYPE_CD AS riskTypeCd , D.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , A.HAZARD_CD AS hazardCd , CASE WHEN A.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN A.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , A.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , A.INIT_RISK_LV AS initRiskLv , A.INIT_DESC AS initDesc , DATE_FORMAT(A.INIT_ASSESS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS initAssessDate , DATE_FORMAT(A.INIT_ASSESS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS occurredDate , A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD AS initFileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'FILE_PATH', A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD, NULL) AS initFilePath FROM TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT A INNER JOIN ( SELECT SV.SYST_VAL_D_CD , SV.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D SV WHERE SV.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND SV.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON (A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD) INNER JOIN ( SELECT BV.BAIM_VAL_D_CD , BV.BAIM_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_BAIM_VAL_D BV WHERE BV.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND BV.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND BV.USE_YN = 'Y' ) C ON (A.PROCESS_CD = C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD) INNER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE D ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = D.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND A.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID = #{userCd} ORDER BY A.INIT_ASSESS_DATE DESC
